title: Rollout failure mitigation — UX guidance, retry affordances, and QA handoff
creator: Aisha Romero
description: Create a design deliverable and guidance for the Redwood Console that standardizes how rollout failures and partial degradations surface to operators. Focus areas: inline failure states on the Rollouts timeline, clear retry/backoff affordances, an operator-facing summary card with SLO impact, and links to observability artifacts. Deliverables include high-fidelity frames for desktop/tablet, a compact mobile fallback, copy variants, and a QA checklist for engineering/handoff.
acceptance_criteria: High-fidelity mockups for Rollouts timeline failure states delivered in Figma with annotated redlines
Copy variants (user-facing and operator-facing) reviewed and approved by PM
QA checklist attached and reviewed with Eng lead
Design tokens and CSS variable mapping provided for dev (colors, icons, transitions)
Accessibility notes: keyboard focus states, ARIA labels, contrast ratios meet WCAG 2.1 AA
review_comments: PM (Sofia Patel) 2026-02-20: Prefer explicit 'pause rollout' action over auto-pause by default; add guidance on when auto-resume is acceptable.
Eng (Marcus Nguyen) 2026-02-24: Need a compact telemetry link that surfaces last 5 errors and quick jump into traces; ensure the UI doesn't cause additional API calls on hover.
Security (Riya Banerjee) 2026-02-26: Audit link should be visible only to users with 'view-audit' permission; call this out in handoff.
Design critique (team) 2026-03-01: Motion on error card entrance feels too slow; suggested 160ms ease-out. Also request alternative microcopy for customers vs. platform engineers.
decisions: Primary action: surface 'Pause Rollout' as prominent primary CTA in failure card; secondary 'Retry Step' for single-step errors
Auto-pause during cascading failures will be opt-in and not default; include an explicit toggle in rollout settings
Failure card will include a condensed SLO impact line (e.g., '5m latency spike, <1% error rate increase') with a link to Observability for details
Telemetry jump links will use deep links to the observability dashboard and open in a new tab to avoid losing console context

qa_checklist: Verify failure card appears for simulated failed step in staging cluster
Confirm deep links open Observability and preserve query params
Keyboard navigation: focus order includes Pause/Retrieve buttons and telemetry link
Screen reader: error card announced as 'Rollout step failed' with concise reason
Responsive: timeline failure pin scales and truncates gracefully at <= 360px width
Edge cases: very long error messages are collapsed with 'show more' affordance
Performance: failure card render should not exceed 30ms on list render for 100 rollouts

notes_for_engineering: Do not prefetch observability payloads on hover — use explicit click to retrieve details
Expose a small query parameter format for deep links: observability?rollout_id={id}&window=5m
Provide server-side truncation or sanitization for error reason to avoid XSS in timeline tooltips
Use CSS variables --error-bg, --error-border, --accent-retry for theming; document fallback values
